views.name: curation_queue_facts
views.definition:
WITH latest AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (price_observation.product_id) price_observation.id,
            price_observation.product_id,
            price_observation.tenant_id,
            price_observation.price_cents,
            price_observation.original_price_cents,
            price_observation.claimed_discount_rate,
            price_observation.rating_star,
            price_observation.sales_label,
            price_observation.sales_count,
            price_observation.observed_at
           FROM garimpa.price_observation
          ORDER BY price_observation.product_id, price_observation.observed_at DESC, price_observation.id DESC
        ), stats AS (
         SELECT l_1.product_id,
            count(o.id)::integer AS observation_count,
            floor(EXTRACT(epoch FROM l_1.observed_at - min(o.observed_at)) / 86400::numeric)::integer AS history_days,
            min(o.price_cents) FILTER (WHERE o.id <> l_1.id) AS previous_min_price_cents
           FROM latest l_1
             JOIN garimpa.price_observation o ON o.product_id = l_1.product_id AND o.tenant_id = l_1.tenant_id
          GROUP BY l_1.product_id, l_1.tenant_id, l_1.id, l_1.observed_at
        ), first_run AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (price_observation.product_id) price_observation.product_id,
            price_observation.capture_run_id
           FROM garimpa.price_observation
          WHERE price_observation.capture_run_id IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY price_observation.product_id, price_observation.observed_at, price_observation.id
        )
 SELECT p.id,
    p.tenant_id,
    p.marketplace,
    p.external_id,
    p.title,
    p.product_url,
    p.image_url,
    p.category,
    p.last_seen_at,
    p.family_key,
    p.family_label,
    p.family_method,
    p.family_version,
    c.status,
    c.reason_code,
    c.reason_detail,
    c.deferred_until,
    c.created_at AS queued_at,
    l.price_cents,
    l.original_price_cents,
    l.claimed_discount_rate,
    l.rating_star,
    l.sales_label,
    l.sales_count,
    l.observed_at,
    s.observation_count,
    s.history_days,
    s.previous_min_price_cents,
    s.observation_count >= 3 AND s.history_days >= 7 AND l.price_cents <= s.previous_min_price_cents AS lowest_verified,
    fr.capture_run_id AS presenting_capture_run_id,
    run.marketplace AS presenting_marketplace,
    run.parameters ->> 'capturePlanId'::text AS presenting_plan_id,
    run.parameters ->> 'captureQueryId'::text AS presenting_query_id,
    run.parameters ->> 'captureMode'::text AS presenting_mode,
    run.parameters ->> 'targetCategory'::text AS presenting_target_category,
    run.parameters ->> 'targetFamily'::text AS presenting_target_family
   FROM garimpa.product_curation c
     JOIN garimpa.product p ON p.id = c.product_id AND p.tenant_id = c.tenant_id
     JOIN latest l ON l.product_id = p.id AND l.tenant_id = p.tenant_id
     JOIN stats s ON s.product_id = p.id
     LEFT JOIN first_run fr ON fr.product_id = p.id
     LEFT JOIN garimpa.capture_run run ON run.id = fr.capture_run_id AND run.tenant_id = p.tenant_id;

         ) as role_active

  where d.token_hash = p_token_hash
  limit 1;

           select 1
           from garimpa.app_user_role aur
           join garimpa.affiliate_membership am
             on am.app_user_id = aur.app_user_id

           where aur.app_user_id = d.created_by_app_user_id

select
    a.id as affiliate_id,
    a.tenant_id,
    a.public_slug,
    a.display_name,
    a.status as account_status,
    m.role as membership_role,
    u.id as app_user_id,
    coalesce(r.role::text, 'comprador') as app_role

  join garimpa.affiliate_membership m on m.app_user_id = u.id and m.revoked_at is null

  order by (a.id = 'aff_local') desc, a.created_at asc;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION garimpa.resolve_actor_identity(p_auth_user_id text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, tenant_id text, roles text[])
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'garimpa'
AS $function$
  select u.id,u.tenant_id,coalesce(array_agg(r.role::text) filter(where r.revoked_at is null and r.role is not null),array[]::text[])
  from garimpa.app_user u left join garimpa.app_user_role r on r.app_user_id=u.id
  where u.auth_user_id=p_auth_user_id group by u.id,u.tenant_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION garimpa.seed_product_curation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into garimpa.product_curation (tenant_id, product_id, status)
  values (new.tenant_id, new.id, 'pending')
  on conflict (tenant_id, product_id) do nothing;
  return new;
end;
$function$
